COLD-FABLESS-B19.reader_question: A lot changes partners. What goes with it?
COLD-FABLESS-B19.description: Two neutral partner work areas, a sealed wafer protective carrier and wholly blank accompanying record sheets at a handoff point. No actual customer shipment or shipping status. Partner handoff coordination hook; blank paper only. Exact approved words only. Blank paper everywhere; no chart, tick, date, status, forecast curve, metric, technical chip UI, customer facility/marks or geography decoration. Keep full-width source paragraphs on white at least body-sized; shrink scene before type. Official logo once, exact category/sequence, no extra header label.
